page.layout: One page of text in a single column; under the text a footnote in smaller italic type with a mark at its left; at the foot a catchword at right and a signature at left. No margin notes. The strip at the left edge is part of the neighbouring page and is left out.

main_text.p: Item ordinari nonnunquam videmus indignos, non secundum Dei voluntate; sed humana præsumtione, &c. Propter quod diligenter de traditi-one divina & apostolica observati-one servandum est, & tenendum, quod apud nos quoque & fere per provincias universas tenetur, ut ad ordinationes ritè celebrandas, ad eam plebem, cui præpositus ordi-natur, episcopi ejusdem provinciæ proximi quinque conveniant, & episcopus deligatur plebe præsente, qui singulorum vitam plenissimè novit, & unicuiusque actum de ejus conversatione perspexit. Augustinus Epist. 110 [?] quod Eradium cupe-ret successorem oratione suavissi-mâ proponit populo, & inquit: Quia scio, post abitus episcoporum, per ambitiosos aut contentiosos solere ecclesias perturbari, debeo, quantum ad me attinet, ne contin-gat huic prospicere civitati.

p.i: Haud dissentiunt doctores pontificii. Toletus Jesuita in Instruct. sacerd. lib. 1. c.

page.notes: The footnote mark at its left is a row of small symbols and is not legible as a single letter; the footnote is set in italic. The faint pencil figures at the lower left corner ("23J0b") are handwriting or a library mark and are left out. "Epist. 110" and "Eradium" are read from a low-contrast scan and are doubtful; the number in the Augustine citation is marked [?]. The catchword "3. Ord.-" is read at the foot right and may be a running title rather than a catchword.
